howStoriesHelp.emotionDesc: Stories trigger feelings, which are powerful memory anchors.
howStoriesHelp.structureDesc: A beginning, middle, and end give our brain a framework to hang information on.
howStoriesHelp.visualDesc: Descriptive language creates vivid mental pictures we can recall easily.
howStoriesHelp.connectionDesc: We remember stories that reflect our own experiences or aspirations.
